summary_en: This phase 0/1 study tests letrozole, given together with standard therapy, in people with recurrent high grade gliomas, a type of brain tumor. Letrozole is taken by mouth once daily, starting at 2.5 mg in the dose-finding part and at 15 mg in the expansion cohort, where it is combined with temozolomide 50 mg/m2 by mouth once daily after a 7-day letrozole lead-in; total treatment duration is not stated. The study measures how well letrozole penetrates the blood brain barrier and concentrates in gliomas, along with its safety and tolerability.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 0/1 evalúa letrozol, administrado junto con terapia estándar, en personas con gliomas de alto grado recurrentes, un tipo de tumor cerebral. El letrozol se toma por vía oral una vez al día, comenzando con 2,5 mg en la parte de ajuste de dosis y con 15 mg en la cohorte de expansión, donde se combina con temozolomida 50 mg/m2 por vía oral una vez al día tras un periodo previo de 7 días con letrozol; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide qué tan bien el letrozol atraviesa la barrera hematoencefálica y se concentra en los gliomas, así como su seguridad y tolerabilidad.
who_for: Recurrent high grade glioma, with a plan for resection or biopsy
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function within set limits
Able to understand and sign written informed consent
not_for: Allergic reaction attributed to letrozole or other study agents (TMZ in sub-study)
Uncontrolled illness, such as recent heart events in last 6 months, active infection, hepatitis B or C, AIDS, or psychiatric illness
Pregnant or nursing women, or patients attempting to conceive
Negative pregnancy test required within 2 weeks for women of childbearing potential
